background_knowledge: 在现代观测天文学中，大规模多目标光谱巡天（如 DESI 以及规划中的 Spec-S5、WST 等）依赖数万根光纤将望远镜焦平面上的天体光信号高效传输至光谱仪。光纤在实际安装与望远镜运行过程中会承受各种复杂的机械形变（如弯折、扭转、夹持载荷等），进而引发焦比退化（Focal Ratio Degradation, FRD）。FRD 是指光束经光纤传输后出射锥角变大（即焦比降低）的光学现象，它会导致进入光谱仪的光束发散超出孔径，引起通量损失并降低系统整体透过率。精确测量并表征大规模光纤在复杂应力环境下的 FRD 和透过率特性，对于大型光谱仪器的光学设计、高精度流量定标以及精确扣除天空背景具有至关重要的意义。
contribution: 本文针对未来超大规模光谱巡天设施（如 Spec-S5 和 WST 等拥有超 25,000 根光纤的系统）光纤测试效率低下的问题，开发了一套**自动化多重应力光纤 FRD 与透过率表征平台**。该系统通过定制的软硬件集成，实现了在系统性改变光线入射角、波长、弯曲半径、扭转角及外部施加压缩载荷等单一或复合应力条件下的自动化数据采集与分析。对多模光纤的基准验证表明，该平台能精确分辨光纤性能随应力变化的细微与显著响应：不仅重现了 FRD 对**入射角与弯曲半径的经典依赖性**，发现光纤在测试条件下对**外部压缩载荷的敏感性相对较弱**，还观测到了 FRD 对**光纤扭转角具有可重复的周期性依赖特征**；同时，相对透过率测试指出**入射角增大导致的通量下降无法单纯用几何投影面积模型解释**。该系统为下一代光谱巡天的大规模光纤测试提供了高度可扩展且通用的自动化解决方案。
summary: Future spectroscopic survey facilities such as Spec-S5 and the Wide-Field Spectroscopic Telescope (WST) will contain more than 25,000 optical fibers. Characterizing the focal ratio degradation (FRD) and throughput of these fibers is essential for spectroscopic calibration, sky subtraction, and overall instrument performance, but manual testing of such large fiber populations is prohibitively time-consuming. In this work, we present an automated multi-stressor optical fiber characterization platform capable of measuring both FRD and relative throughput while systematically varying optical and mechanical stress conditions. The system enables characterization as a function of input angle, wavelength, bend radius, twist angle, and externally applied load, while also allowing combinations of stressors to be investigated simultaneously. A custom software framework automates hardware control, data acquisition, and data analysis, enabling large characterization campaigns to be performed with minimal user intervention. Validation measurements performed on a multimode optical fiber demonstrate the ability of the platform to resolve both pronounced and subtle stress-dependent variations in FRD and relative throughput. The results show the expected dependence of FRD on input angle and bend radius, reveal comparatively weak sensitivity to externally applied compressive loading under the investigated conditions, and identify a reproducible periodic dependence on fiber twist angle. In addition, relative throughput measurements indicate that the reduction in relative throughput with increasing input angle cannot be explained solely by a simple projected-area model. The automated workflow and scalability of the system provide a versatile framework for the large-scale characterization of optical fibers required by next-generation spectroscopic survey facilities.

title: Water enhances the formation of refractory sulfur in interstellar ices
background_knowledge: 硫（S）是宇宙中丰度排名前十的元素之一，但在低温稠密的星际分子云和恒星形成区，天文观测到的气相硫丰度远低于其宇宙理论丰度，这种现象被称为天体化学中的“硫亏缺问题”（Sulfur Depletion Problem）。天文学界普遍推测，大量缺失的硫被吸附并固化在星际尘埃颗粒表面的冰幔（Ice Mantle）或难以挥发的固态物质中。在星际空间中，尘埃冰幔主要由水冰（$\text{H}_2\text{O}$）主导，并包含 $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ 等挥发性分子；当受到紫外（UV）辐射、宇宙线粒子轰击以及原恒星形成时的热扰动后，冰幔内会引发复杂的固相化学演化，生成耐高温的难挥发性残余物。
contribution: 本研究通过实验室模拟星际冰化学演化，对含 $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ 的冰模拟物（对比含水与无水环境）进行紫外光照和升温热处理，并分析了生成的难挥发残留物。主要科学发现包括：1. **水冰大幅促进难挥发硫的生成**：实验证实含 $\text{H}_2\text{S}$ 冰层经光热演化可形成 $\text{S}_6$–$\text{S}_8$ 等硫同素异形体，且**水冰基质的存在将这些硫同素异形体的产率提高了两个数量级**；2. **揭示了分子链增长机制**：提出水冰基质能有效稳定离子反应中间体，促进硫链生长和环化，主要产物为 $\text{S}_8$；3. **为星际“硫亏缺”提供了关键固相载体**：实验产物中的硫同素异形体与连多硫酸盐物质与陨石及小行星采样结果高度吻合，**证实这类高密度容纳硫原子的难挥发分子是稠密分子云中固相硫的高效储存库**，并可作为示踪星际水冰环境的重要化学指标。
summary: Sulfur is the tenth most abundant element in space, yet it is strongly depleted in the gas phase of dense interstellar regions, suggesting sequestration in dust grain components that are difficult to detect. We study whether UV irradiation and thermal processing of H2S-containing interstellar-ice analogues can produce refractory sulfur species, and whether water-dominated ice enhances their formation. We performed UV irradiation and warm-up experiments on H2S-containing ice analogues with and without water, and the resulting refractory residues were analysed ex situ. Refractory sulfur species, including the sulfur allotropes S6-S8, are formed during UV irradiation and thermal processing of H2S-containing interstellar-ice analogues. Water enhances the formation of these sulfur allotropes by two orders of magnitude. We propose a formation mechanism in which ionic intermediates stabilised by the water-ice matrix promote chain growth and cyclisation, yielding predominantly S8. The combined detection in our residues of sulfur allotropes and polythionic species, also reported in meteorites and samples returned from asteroids, supports their formation in pre-cometary ice mantles covering dust grains. Because these species can incorporate multiple sulfur atoms per molecule, they constitute an efficient solid-phase reservoir for the missing sulfur in dense cloud environments where young stars are born. Refractory sulfur can therefore serve as a tracer of water-ice environments in space.

title: LeoNet: A Machine Learning Method for Binary Pulsar Classification
background_knowledge: 双星脉冲星是由脉冲星与致密伴星（如白矮星、中子星或黑洞）组成的极端天体系统，是检验广义相对论及强引力场理论不可替代的天然物理实验室。在传统的射电天文脉冲星搜寻中，孤立脉冲星表现为高度稳定的周期性脉冲信号，通常采用傅里叶变换进行周期搜索。然而，在双星系统中，脉冲星沿轨道运动引发的显著多普勒效应（Doppler shift）会导致观测到的脉冲周期随时间持续漂移，从而将傅里叶频域内的信号功率弥散到多个频率仓中，严重降低探测信噪比。传统方法多采用傅里叶域加速度搜索（FDAS）和加加速度（Jerk）搜索等匹配滤波技术来校正频移，但这需要遍历庞大的高维参数网格，计算代价极其昂贵。随着 FAST、SKA 等下一代巨型射电望远镜的运行，海量数据流对高效、实时的双星脉冲星盲搜算法提出了迫切需求。
contribution: 本研究提出了一种用于双星脉冲星信号分类的卷积神经网络架构 **LeoNet**。该模型通过 10 个可学习滤波器提取受多普勒频移影响的信号特征，构建低维紧凑的 10 通道特征图，替代了传统计算昂贵的显式加速度-加加速度响应网格，并由卷积分类器完成候选信号的识别。在 $500\text{ s}$ 模拟观测数据测试中，LeoNet 相比经典天文学搜寻软件 PRESTO 的加速度搜索配置，在 5 种采样间隔下实现了 **假阴性率（False Negative Rate）平均相对降低 55.5%** 的探测性能。在计算效率方面，经 TensorRT 优化的 LeoNet 在 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上的单次观测全流程处理时间仅为 **$3.44 \sim 4.37\text{ ms}$**；在 $128\ \mu\text{s}$ 采样间隔下平均耗时 $3.54\text{ ms}$，相较于 AMD CPU 上的 PRESTO FDAS 算法实现了 **约 499 倍的计算加速**。结果表明，LeoNet 兼具高探测灵敏度与毫秒级推理速度，为下一代巡天管线的 **实时双星脉冲星候选体筛选** 提供了极具前景的机器学习解决方案。
summary: Binary pulsars provide valuable laboratories for testing theories of gravity, but orbital Doppler shifts complicate their detection. Fourier-domain acceleration and jerk searches address this challenge via matched filtering, but at substantial computational cost. We present LeoNet, a convolutional neural network that uses ten learnable filters to extract features of signals affected by Doppler shifts. The resulting ten-channel feature map provides a compact, lower-dimensional alternative to an explicitly sampled acceleration-jerk response grid and is analysed by a convolutional classifier to identify candidate signals. For simulated observations lasting 500 s, LeoNet achieves a mean relative reduction in false negative rate of 55.5% across five sampling intervals compared with the evaluated PRESTO acceleration-search configuration. TensorRT-optimised LeoNet processes each 500 s observation in 3.44-4.37 ms in FP32 on an NVIDIA H100 PCIe GPU across eight sampling intervals, including preprocessing, inference, and postprocessing. At a sampling interval of 128 microseconds, its mean processing time is 3.54 ms, compared with 1.767 s for PRESTO FDAS on an AMD EPYC 9825 CPU with search-frequency limits of 96-1000 Hz, corresponding to an approximately 499-fold speedup in the measured processing time. These results suggest that LeoNet has the potential to improve detection performance, while its millisecond-scale processing time supports its use as a candidate-identification stage in real-time binary pulsar search pipelines.

title: Near-Noiseless Single-Photon Detection in the Infrared with a Megapixel Semiconductor Array for Low-Background Astronomy
background_knowledge: 在极低流量的天文成像与高分辨率红外光谱观测中，探测器读出噪声是制约观测灵敏度的核心瓶颈。实现单光子分辨（Single-photon Resolving）是突破该极限的理想方案。尽管可见光波段已有成熟的半导体单光子探测器，但在红外波段，高灵敏度单光子探测历来高度依赖超导探测器（如 TES 或 SNSPD）。超导器件需要在接近绝对零度（低于 $1\text{ K}$）的极低温和高功耗环境下工作，难以大规模扩展为百万像素级焦平面阵列。碲镉汞（HgCdTe）线性模式雪崩光电二极管（LmAPD）通过材料内部的电子碰撞电离在读出前放大电荷信号，能够在常规低温区（数十开尔文）克服读出噪声，但在微弱信号应用中一直受制于暗电流和带间隧穿效应。
contribution: 本文成功展示了在常规低温环境下运行的**百万像素级 HgCdTe 线性模式雪崩光电二极管（LmAPD）阵列的单光子分辨探测能力**。研究团队利用雪崩增益将无损斜坡采样（up-the-ramp）中的光子阶跃信号提升至读出噪声基准以上，同时暗信号未被显著放大，实现了仅约**每像素每千次读出产生 $2$ 次虚警计数**（False positive rate）的超低噪声性能。该成果证明了 LmAPD 阵列是未来低背景空间及地面天文望远镜构建**大画幅红外光子计数焦平面**的可行且极具前景的技术路线。
summary:
Sensor noise is a fundamental barrier to low-flux astronomical imaging and spectroscopy, where the ideal sensor would unambiguously distinguish individual photon arrivals. While optical semiconductor arrays can reach single-photon sensitivity, comparable performance in the infrared has largely required superconducting detectors. These must be operated at temperatures near absolute zero and require substantially more power, introducing major system-level challenges. HgCdTe avalanche photodiodes offer a semiconductor alternative by amplifying charge before readout, but dark current and tunneling effects have limited their use in the faintest regimes.
  Here we demonstrate single-photon-resolving operation in a megapixel-format HgCdTe linear-mode avalanche photodiode array operated at conventional cryogenic temperature. Avalanche gain raises photon-induced steps in non-destructive up-the-ramp data above the readout-noise floor while leaving the dark signal largely unamplified, with a false positive rate of approximately 2 false counts per thousand reads per pixel. These results establish LmAPDs as a promising route toward infrared photon-counting focal planes for future low-background astronomical observatories.

title: Normalizing Flow Emulator for Gravitational Wave Detection Probability in the LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA O4 Observing Run
background_knowledge: 引力波天文学是探测致密天体双星（如双黑洞、双中子星等）并合过程及开展恒星演化与宇宙学研究的核心途径。在利用地基引力波探测器网络（如 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA）进行致密双星星族统计推断时，观测数据会受到显著的选择效应（Selection Effects）影响——探测器对质量更大、距离更近或空间取向更优的并合事件具有更高的灵敏度。为了从有限且带有偏差的探测样本中准确反演天体物理真实的源内禀分布（如质量谱、自旋分布及红移演化率），必须精确量化任意源参数下的引力波探测概率（Detection Probability）。传统方法依赖于计算开销巨大的大规模蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）波形注入测试，且在评估具有尖锐突变特征的复杂星族模型时容易引入较大的统计采样误差。因此，利用生成式机器学习算法（如归一化流）构建探测概率仿真器，已成为加速引力波星族贝叶斯推断的关键前沿工具。
contribution:
本文提出了一种基于**归一化流（Normalizing Flows, NFs）**的机器学习仿真器，用于高效且高精度地评估类 LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA O4 观测运行期网络下的引力波探测概率。主要科学贡献与成果包括：
1. 利用公开的引力波注入数据集训练并验证了归一化流模型，证明其作为生成模型能够**准确重构已探测引力波事件的多维参数分布**；
2. 将该仿真器预测的探测效率与传统蒙特卡洛重要性采样进行对比，二者呈现出**高度一致性**；
3. 证实了在面对包含尖锐几何特征等广泛的星族模型时，NF 仿真器能获得**显著优于传统蒙特卡洛重要性采样的估计精度**；
4. 成功展示了该工具在引力波**星族推断分析**中的实用价值，并全面开源了模型及训练代码。
summary: Efficient and accurate estimation of the detection probability of a gravitational wave event given its source parameters remains a challenging problem because it conventionally requires expensive Monte Carlo injection campaigns. We present a machine learning-based approach using Normalizing Flows (NFs) to estimate the detection probability of gravitational wave events for a LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA O4-like detector network configuration. We utilize the publicly available injection dataset as training and test data. We test our method and implementation by evaluating the raw NF performance as a generative model based on its ability to recover the correct parameter distributions of detected events. In addition, we compare the detection efficiencies predicted by the NF emulator with those from Monte Carlo importance sampling and find good agreement. Furthermore, estimating the detection efficiency for a wide variety of population models, including those with sharp features, can be more precise than estimates obtained via Monte Carlo importance sampling. We show that the NF emulator can be used in population analysis of gravitational wave sources, similar to previous neural network approaches. The training code and trained models from this work are publicly available.

title: Weighing Galaxies Inside-Out: Small-Scale Lensing and the Stellar Mass Problem
background_knowledge: 星系-星系弱引力透镜（Galaxy-Galaxy Weak Lensing, GGWL）是通过统计测量前景透镜星系周围背景源星系的微弱引力剪切效应，从而无偏探测星系质量分布与暗物质晕性质的关键天体物理探针。在星系形成与演化领域，准确测量星系的恒星质量高度依赖于恒星初始质量函数（Initial Mass Function, IMF）的假定；然而，基于光谱或测光拟合推断恒星质量常受到模型简并的制约，由此引出了所谓的“恒星质量问题”，通常使用恒星质量不匹配参数 $α$（即动力学/引力测量的恒星质量与特定标准 IMF 假设下恒星质量的比值）来量化其偏离。小尺度弱引力透镜能够深入星系内部（重子物质与暗物质共存的过渡区域），为解耦恒星与暗物质分布、独立检验 IMF 提供了可能。但在极小尺度下，前景透镜星系本身的弥散星光会对背景源星系的探测、测光和形状测量产生严重的系统偏差，如何有效扣除透镜光是实现高精度测量的核心挑战。
contribution: 本工作基于面向 DESI 亮星系巡天（BGS）设计的逼真模拟星表，对未来 *Euclid* 空间望远镜在约 $9000\,\mathrm{deg}^2$ 重叠天区内的小尺度星系-星系弱透镜观测能力进行了科学前景预测。研究重点评估了前景透镜星光对弱透镜信号测量的系统误差影响，证明使用 \textsc{Galfit} 扣除透镜光能够将相关偏差**降低近一个数量级**，并将可靠测量的尺度推进至 **$4$ 倍半光半径**处。对恒星质量在 $9.5 \le \log(M_*/h^{-2}M_\odot) \le 11.5$ 且投影距离在 $10 \sim 100\,h^{-1}\mathrm{kpc}$ 范围内的中心星系建模显示，中等质量星系的透镜信号信噪比**可达到约 $150$**。在假设暗物质晕服从 NFW 轮廓的前提下，该方法对全样本和大质量星系的恒星不匹配参数 $α$ 的约束精度分别可达到 **约 $8.5\%$** 和 **$8.6\%$**，有力证明了小尺度弱引力透镜作为**精确探查恒星 IMF 及星系内部恒星-暗物质关联**的强大潜力。
summary: Small-scale galaxy-galaxy weak lensing provides an independent way to probe the stellar initial mass function by constraining the matter distribution within galaxies. We forecast the potential of upcoming \textit{Euclid} observations using realistic mock catalogues designed for a DESI-like Bright Galaxy Survey, which is expected to cover approximately $9000\,\mathrm{deg}^2$ of the \textit{Euclid} wide survey area. We assess the impact of foreground lens light, which introduces significant scale-dependent biases in source detection, photometry, and shape measurements. Subtracting the lens light with \textsc{Galfit} reduces these biases by nearly an order of magnitude at scales down to four times the half-light radius. We model the predicted lensing signal around central galaxies with stellar masses between $9.5 \leq \log(M_*/h^{-2}M_\odot) \leq 11.5$ over projected separations of $10$ to $100\,h^{-1}\mathrm{kpc}$. The resulting signal-to-noise ratios reach $\sim 150$ for intermediate-mass galaxies. Assuming an NFW profile for the dark matter contribution, we constrain the stellar mismatch parameter $α$ to a precision of approximately $8.5$ percent for the full sample and $8.6$ percent for massive galaxies. These results highlight the potential of small-scale galaxy--galaxy weak lensing as a robust probe of the IMF and the connection between stellar and dark matter in galaxies using upcoming \textit{Euclid} data.

title: Intrinsic versus observation induced spin nonstationarity in pulsar timing
background_knowledge: 脉冲星是高速自转的致密中子星，其极高的自转稳定性使其成为研究极端物理与天文测时的理想天体。然而，长期观测表明脉冲星自转常伴有低频随机涨落，即“自转噪声”（Spin Noise）。在理论上，中子星通常被建模为包含刚性固态外壳（Crust）和内部超流体（Superfluid）的两分量系统，自转噪声的统计平稳性（Stationarity）直接取决于中子星角动量是在内外分量之间内部守恒交换，还是受到外界独立的随机力矩干扰。然而，射电脉冲星测时（Pulsar Timing）只能直接追踪外壳的转动相位，并且在分析中必须拟合并减去确定性的测时模型（Timing Model），这使得直接从观测相位推断中子星内部动力学与噪声平稳性面临显著的技术挑战。
contribution: 本文提出了一种**基于高斯过程（Gaussian Process）检验脉冲星自转噪声平稳性**的新方法，利用奇异非平稳与极小自转平稳两分量模型的解析相位协方差，构建了计算复杂度随观测点数线性增长的似然函数，并解析边际化了测时模型。模拟数据分析表明，测时模型的扣除与差分运算并不会凭空创造或消除噪声平稳性的本质区别，但会限制有限噪声数据中所能保留的判别信息。研究指出，在**仅能观测到外壳相位的情况下，两类模型拟合效果相当且贝叶斯因子接近于 1**；但极小模型通过超流体转动惯量占比将隐藏的超流体运动与外壳观测紧密关联，为**结合脉冲星突变（Glitch）与未来的连续引力波（Continuous Gravitational Waves）观测检验中子星内部动力学**提供了可证伪的预测。
summary: Whether spin noise of a neutron star is stationary is, in two-component models, a question of whether stellar angular momentum is conserved internally or exchanged externally through independent stochastic torques on the crust and superfluid. The question is posed in the two components' angular velocities, but radio pulsar timing observes only the crust, through its rotational phase after a deterministic timing model is fitted. We develop a Gaussian process method for testing spin noise stationarity directly with such phase data. Starting from the exact analytical phase means and covariances of a singular, nonstationary and a minimal, stationary two-component model, we show that the crust phase covariances are semiseparable and construct a likelihood that scales linearly with the number of observations, with the timing model marginalized analytically. We analyze simulated phase data from both models using full-state and crust-only observations, and after differentiation into local spin frequencies. Integration, timing model removal and differentiation neither create nor destroy the distinction between stationary and nonstationary spin noise, but determine how much survives in a finite, noisy data set. With both components observed, the models are distinguished decisively and the generating parameters are recovered. With the crust alone, both models describe the observed phase equally well over much of parameter space, and the Bayes factors are of order unity and prior-limited. The minimal model nonetheless ties the hidden superfluid phase to the observed crust phase through a single factor set by the superfluid inertia fraction, so an independent estimate of this fraction, as from glitches, turns it into a falsifiable prediction that a continuous gravitational wave observation of the interior could test.

title: LIGHTS. Limitations of Far-Infrared Tracers for Galactic Cirrus Mitigation in the Era of Ultra-Deep Imaging
background_knowledge: 银河系卷云（Galactic cirrus）是由银河系高银纬及盘面弥散的星际尘埃云构成的结构。这些微米至亚微米级的尘埃颗粒在吸收星光后于远红外波段产生热辐射，同时也会散射来自银河系恒星盘面的光学波段光子，在深场光学成像中表现为极其微弱且形态复杂的弥散背景。随着当代及下一代超深光学巡天（如 LSST、LIGHTS 等）的探测极限突破 $30\text{ mag/arcsec}^2$，银河系卷云的光学散射光成为了显著的前景污染源，严重干扰对河外星系极低表面亮度结构（如恒星晕、潮汐尾、并合遗迹及超弥散星系）的精确测量。天文学界通常依赖高灵敏度的远红外空间望远镜（如 Herschel）数据作为尘埃示踪剂，以期在光学图像中建模并扣除卷云成分。
contribution:
本文基于 LIGHTS 巡天等数据，深入评估了利用远红外示踪剂扣除超深光学成像中银河系卷云的可行性与极限，主要结论包括：
1. **定量确定了光学与远红外辐射的对应比例**：在光学薄尘埃假设下，对于表面亮度 $\mu_g \gtrsim 27\text{ mag/arcsec}^2$ 的银河系卷云，Sloan $g$ 和 $r$ 波段的光学散射发射与 Herschel $250\ \mu\text{m}$ 远红外发射之间符合良好的线性关系，其中光学波段卷云发射强度约为远红外通量的 $\sim 0.1\%$。
2. **揭示了现有远红外示踪剂的空间分辨率瓶颈**：尽管 Herschel 数据能够在大天区尺度上识别卷云，但其有限的空间分辨率引入了严重的源混叠效应（source confusion），限制了光学图像能够稳健达到的有效表面亮度深度。
3. **给出了当前远红外建模的实际深度极限**：研究表明利用 Herschel $250\ \mu\text{m}$ 建模卷云时，其极限表面亮度仅为 $\mu_V \sim 28\text{ mag/arcsec}^2$，**远浅于 LIGHTS 或 LSST 10 年叠加数据所达到的名义探测深度（$\mu_V \sim 30.5\text{ mag/arcsec}^2$）**。\n该成果明确了当前远红外数据在超深光学去噪中的根本局限，强调了未来亟需获取更高分辨率的卷云示踪数据以充分释放下一代深场巡天的科学潜力。
summary: Current and forthcoming deep optical imaging surveys are reaching surface brightness levels fainter than 30 mag/arcsec$^2$, where Galactic cirrus emission becomes a significant contaminant. This poses a major challenge for the study of extremely low-surface-brightness extragalactic structures. We investigate the relationship between far-infrared emission, as traced by the Herschel 250 $μ$m band, and optical surface brightness in the Sloan \textit{g}- and \textit{r}-bands. We find that, for Galactic cirrus with $μ_g\gtrsim$~27 mag/arcsec$^2$, a linear relation is consistent with the data, assuming optically thin dust, with optical cirrus emission amounting to $\sim$0.1\% of the far-infrared flux. Using Herschel far-infrared data to trace Galactic cirrus enables its identification over wide areas, but at the cost of significantly reducing spatial resolution. This limitation introduces source confusion and restricts the effective surface brightness depth that can be robustly probed in optical data. We show that, when cirrus emission is modeled using Herschel 250 $μ$m data, the limiting surface brightness is $μ_V\sim$~28 mag/arcsec$^2$, substantially shallower than the nominal depth of surveys such as LIGHTS or the 10-year coadd LSST ($μ_V\sim$~30.5 mag/arcsec$^2$). These results highlight a fundamental limitation in the use of currently available far-infrared data for cirrus mitigation in ultra-deep optical imaging, and emphasize the need for higher-resolution cirrus tracers to fully exploit the depth of upcoming surveys.

title: Optimal Pulsar Timing Array Strategies with the Deep Synoptic Array
background_knowledge: 脉冲星测时阵列（Pulsar Timing Array, PTA）利用银河系内极端稳定自转的毫秒脉冲星作为天然的“精密时钟”，通过长期高精度监测脉冲到达时间（Time of Arrival, TOA）的细微扰动，来搜寻纳赫兹（nanohertz）低频引力波背景（Gravitational Wave Background, GWB）。该引力波背景通常被认为源于宇宙学尺度上的超大质量双黑洞系统并合或早期宇宙学相变。随着北美 NANOGrav 等国际 PTA 合作组发现低频引力波背景存在的关键证据，如何合理调度新一代大视场、高灵敏度射电望远镜阵列（如 Deep Synoptic Array, DSA），综合考虑辐射计噪声、脉冲相位本征抖动噪声（Jitter noise）以及星际介质效应，并在有限观测时间内优化脉冲星的观测频段与积分时间配置，成为最大化低频引力波探测信噪比与确定其天文物理起源的核心课题。
contribution: 本研究提出了一套用于模拟多望远镜对脉冲星样本进行测时观测的理论与计算框架，能够为单颗脉冲星精确预测最优观测设备、观测频率以及积分时间。作者将该方法应用于 NANOGrav 的 85 颗毫秒脉冲星样本，对比评估了绿岸望远镜（GBT）、甚大阵（VLA）、加拿大氢强度测绘实验（CHIME）与正在建设中的内华达深度天气望远镜阵列（DSA）的性能表现。研究表明，**当前大多数毫秒脉冲星的测时精度并未受限于本征脉冲相位抖动噪声**；同时证明**从头构建基于 DSA 的独立 PTA 系统相较于使用当前传统设备具有更高的探测灵敏度**。最后，在固定总观测时间预算下求解最优积分时间分配方案，发现针对 DSA 早期科学阶段的固定源列表，**优化积分时间相比于源间等时间分配策略仅带来约 $\sim 5\%$ 的 GWB 灵敏度提升**，表明对于 DSA 观测而言积分时间精细优化的边际收益有限。
summary: Pulsar timing array (PTA) experiments have seen evidence for a nanohertz-frequency gravitational wave background (GWB) through coordinated radio timing observations of millisecond pulsars. The significance of this evidence is expected to grow and the GWB's progenitor(s) uncovered with continued observations, especially as the next generation of radio telescopes comes online. We present a framework for simulating timing observations of a set of pulsars with a set of telescopes to predict the per-pulsar optimal instrument, observing frequency, and integration time. We apply this methodology to the NANOGrav source list of 85 pulsars observed with the Green Bank Telescope, Very Large Array, Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME), and the Deep Synoptic Array (DSA), a radio dish array under construction in Nevada. We discuss the dominant noise contributions to the timing precision of these pulsars and show that most are not dominated by intrinsic pulse phase jitter noise. We also determine which pulsars should be timed with DSA and CHIME or only DSA and show that an ab initio DSA PTA is more sensitive than one which uses current instruments. Finally, we solve for the optimal integration time per pulsar, subject to a fixed time budget, that maximizes the GWB signal-to-noise. We show that there is little benefit to optimizing over integration time for these pulsars observed with DSA. Through Monte Carlo realizations of the PTA, we show that the GWB sensitivity improves by $\sim 5\%$ for time-optimized observations compared to the equal-time-per-source scenario with an early-science, fixed source list.

title: Emulation of the Halo Mass Function with Neural Networks
background_knowledge: 暗晕质量函数（Halo Mass Function, 简称 HMF）描述了宇宙中单位体积内不同质量暗晕的数密度分布，是现代宇宙学结构形成理论的核心预言之一。HMF 对宇宙学参数（如物质密度参数 $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}$、物质涨落幅度 $\sigma_8$ 及中微子质量等）以及星系演化中的重子反馈物理极为敏感，因此利用星系团丰度测量 HMF 是开展宇宙学参数精确约束的重要探针。然而，运行高精度的 $N$ 体和流体动力学数值模拟计算成本极高，无法直接满足参数空间遍历（如 MCMC 采样）的需求。为此，天文学界发展了模拟器（Emulator）技术，利用机器学习或高斯过程对稀疏的模拟网格进行插值。然而，传统的 HMF 模拟器通常依赖数据分箱（Binning）或主成分分析（PCA）降维，这不仅会引入信息损失，也难以准确量化预测的内禀误差。
contribution:
本研究开发了一种基于**神经网络的暗晕质量函数模拟器**，用于高效、高精度地预测暗晕累积丰度：
1. **消除信息损失的端到端建模**：该神经网络直接将宇宙学参数、天体物理参数、暗晕质量和红移映射为大于给定质量的暗晕累积计数，彻底**避免了传统方法中分箱（Binning）与 PCA 降维导致的信息损失**。
2. **内置不确定性估计**：网络在预测暗晕计数的同时，自学习预测以**泊松散粒噪声（Poisson shot noise）为基准的模型误差**，为每次预测提供了内建的置信度评估指标。
3. **多模拟套件的高精度泛化验证**：在 MassiveNuS（$N$ 体模拟）、CAMELS IllustrisTNG 和 CAMELS SIMBA（流体模拟）三大模拟套件（涵盖不同盒子尺寸、红移及次网格物理模型，共计 $1.2 \times 10^6$ 次留一测试）中，**88% 的预测模型偏差在散粒噪声以内，99.9% 的偏差在 3 倍散粒噪声以内**。
4. **高误差样本识别与开源应用**：针对高误差尾端，模型自带的误差预测成功标记了 76% 偏差超过 3 倍散粒噪声的样本；该模拟器已完全开源且支持在其他模拟套件上重新训练，为宇宙学和天体物理参数推断提供了高度灵活的工具。
summary: The abundance of galaxy clusters as a function of mass --- the halo mass function (HMF) --- depends strongly on cosmological parameters. Large-scale simulations are computationally expensive, motivating emulators that interpolate simulation outputs. We present a neural network emulator that maps cosmological and astrophysical parameters, halo mass, and redshift directly to a cumulative count of halos above the input mass, avoiding the information loss inherent to binning and to the functional or PCA-based data reduction used in prior emulators. Each emulator prediction is accompanied by a self-estimated error, expressed in units of Poisson shot noise, that the network learns to predict alongside the halo count itself --- giving every output a built-in confidence metric. We validate the emulator with leave-one-out tests on three simulation suites --- the N-body MassiveNus suite and the hydrodynamical CAMELS IllustrisTNG and SIMBA suites --- spanning a range of box sizes, redshifts, sub-grid physics, and softwares. Of all the held-out predictions ($1.2\times 10^6$ in total), 88\% have model bias at or below shot noise and 99.9\% are within $3\times$ shot noise. The only significant high-error tail is in MassiveNus, where the predicted model bias flags 76\% of predictions exceeding $3\times$ shot noise; the remaining number of high error predictions is comparable to the number expected from shot noise alone. This emulator is publicly available and can be trained on other simulation suites making it a flexible HMF tool that can be used for cosmological and astrophysical inference.

title: Extreme Kerr Newman Black Holes: Differential Geometry, Symmetry, and the Golden Ratio
background_knowledge: Kerr-Newman 黑洞是广义相对论中爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦场方程的精确稳态解，完整描述了同时具有质量 $M$、电荷 $Q$ 和角动量 $J$ 的黑洞。在黑洞几何学与黑洞热力学的发展中，Smarr 公式和 Christodoulou 不可约质量（irreducible mass）建立了黑洞宏观参量与视界面积、能量提取之间的基本联系。对于满足极端条件（即内外视界重合、表面引力为零）的极端 Kerr-Newman 黑洞，其视界的内禀微分几何结构、局部曲率分布与对称性，对深入理解黑洞微观态与引力几何基础物理性质具有关键意义。
contribution: 本文深入研究了极端 Kerr-Newman 黑洞的几何结构及其在挑选特殊黑洞物理状态中的作用。基于 Smarr 提出的事件视界对称性蕴含何种物理信息这一问题，作者在 Christodoulou 相图中利用标度化电荷与角动量的离散对称性，**发现了一个质量、电荷、角动量和不可约质量均受单一无理数约束的特殊极端黑洞族**。进一步利用事件视界的局部微分几何性质作为选择原则，在离散对称性 $Q \rightarrow \pm Q$ 和 $J \rightarrow \pm J$ 意义下，**唯一确定了在旋转几何中所能容纳的具有最高局域球对称性的特殊极端 Kerr-Newman 黑洞**。研究表明，**该独特构型的所有相关物理量与几何量（能量、电荷、角动量及不可约质量）仅由黄金分割比（Golden Ratio）精确关联**。此外，论文还分析了相关的可逆与不可逆变换及可提取能量，证明了**视界内禀微分几何能够约束宏观参数并筛选出特定的极端黑洞几何构型**。
summary: We investigate the geometry of extreme Kerr-Newman black holes and its role in selecting distinct black hole states. Motivated by Smarr's question of what physical information is encoded in event-horizon symmetries, we identify, besides the Smarr extreme family, a special family in which the mass, charge, angular momentum, and irreducible mass are constrained by a single irrational number. In the Christodoulou diagram, this family is selected by a discrete symmetry of appropriately scaled charge and angular-momentum variables. The local differential geometry of the event horizon provides an additional selection principle, which, up to the discrete symmetries (Q \rightarrow\pm Q) and (J \rightarrow\pm J), identifies a unique extreme Kerr-Newman black hole exhibiting the highest degree of local spherical symmetry compatible with the rotating Kerr-Newman geometry. Remarkably, for this distinct extreme configuration, all relevant physical and geometrical quantities, including the energy, electric charge, angular momentum, and irreducible mass, are solely related through the golden ratio. We also examine reversible and irreversible transformations and the associated extractable energy. Intrinsic horizon geometry can therefore constrain the macroscopic parameters and single out distinct extreme Kerr-Newman configurations.

title: State of the Art in Direct Dark Matter Detectors: Technologies, Performance, and Future Directions
background_knowledge: 暗物质构成了宇宙中物质总量的绝大部分，但其微观粒子物理本质至今仍是现代物理学和天文学最大的未解之谜之一。弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）以及亚 GeV 尺度的轻质暗物质是极具吸引力的理论候选体。暗物质直接探测实验旨在捕捉太阳系在银河系暗物质晕中运动时，暗物质粒子与地球实验室靶物质原子核或电子发生罕见弹性散射所沉积的微小能量（通常表现为声子、电离或闪烁光信号）。由于预期的反应截面极小，探测器必须部署在极深地下实验室以屏蔽宇宙射线，并具备极高的放射性本底抑制能力与超低能量阈值。随着探测灵敏度的持续提升，来自太阳、大气和超新星的中微子相干弹性核散射（CE$\nu$NS）将形成不可消除的中微子底噪（被称为“中微子雾”，Neutrino Fog），对未来的暗物质发现构成了根本性的物理挑战。
contribution: 本综述全面评估了当前**暗物质直接探测技术的实验现状与前沿进展**。论文根据探测技术固有的物理特性与科学探测极限进行了系统梳理：对比了**多吨级稀有气体时间投影室（TPC）**在探索高质量 WIMP 探测灵敏度前沿的可扩展性优势，以及**低温半导体与电荷耦合器件（CCD）探测器**在亚 GeV 级低质量候选体搜寻中依赖超低能阈展现出的高精度特性；重点阐述了**先进数据重建流程与机器学习（ML）算法**作为探测器核心性能组成部分的关键作用；最后，针对探测器逼近**中微子雾（Neutrino Fog）**本底的严峻挑战，提出了未来十年的战略路线，强调未来突破需依托**多探测技术的全球互补协作**，结合更大靶质量、极低能阈、先进本底鉴别以及**方向性探测和时间特征调制**等独特观测量，以确保在相干中微子散射本底存在下依然保持可靠的暗物质发现能力。
summary: Identifying the particle nature of dark matter remains one of the most significant challenges in modern physics. Direct detection experiments aim to observe rare scattering events between dark matter particles and terrestrial targets, a task that demands extreme background suppression and sensitivity to minute energy depositions. This review critically assesses the current experimental landscape, organizing detector technologies by the fundamental physical trade-offs that define their scientific reach. We contrast the multi-tonne scalability of noble-liquid Time Projection Chambers (TPCs), which currently define the sensitivity frontier for high-mass Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs), with the precision of cryogenic semiconductors and Charge-Coupled Device (CCD)- based sensors, which dominate the search for low-mass and sub-GeV candidates. Special emphasis is placed on the role of advanced reconstruction pipelines and machine learning (ML) as integral components of detector performance. Finally, we discuss the strategic roadmap for the next decade as experiments approach the neutrino fog, where coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering (CEνNS) produces an increasingly significant and ultimately irreducible background that can mimic DM-induced nuclear recoils. We argue that future progress will rely not on a single technology but on a complementary global program combining increased target mass, ultra-low energy thresholds, improved background discrimination, and distinct observables - such as directionality and temporal signatures - to maintain robust discovery capability in the presence of neutrino-induced backgrounds.

title: 25 Years of Mrk 421 with XMM-Newton: Unveiling Structured Jets and Energy-Dependent Escape
background_knowledge: 耀变体（Blazar）是活动星系核（AGN）中极为特殊的一类，其相对论性喷流几乎正对地球视线方向，因而具有显著的多普勒聚束效应、极强的宽波段非热辐射和剧烈的时间变变性。在耀变体的高能辐射模型中，高同步辐射峰频 BL Lac 天体（HSP，如 Mrk 421）的 X 射线辐射主要由喷流内超相对论性电子的同步辐射产生。分析其 X 射线能谱（如幂律、断幂律或对数抛物线模型）及光变特性，是探测喷流内部粒子加速机制（如激波加速与二阶随机湍流加速）以及能量损失与冷却过程（如辐射冷却与粒子逃逸）的关键途径。传统单区均质喷流模型通常预测在同步辐射冷却拐折处能谱指数变陡 $\Delta\Gamma = 0.5$，但实际观测中的复杂能谱特征常提示喷流具有复杂的径向/横向空间结构或非均匀的粒子逃逸机制，需依赖长达数十年的高精度空间 X 射线监测数据来验证。
contribution:
本研究基于 XMM-Newton 卫星在 2000 年至 2025 年间横跨近 25 年的 76 组存档观测数据，对经典 TeV 耀变体 Mrk 421 的长时标 X 射线能谱及光变行为进行了深入分析，主要科学发现如下：

1. **光变统计与硬度演化**：Mrk 421 的 X 射线流量变化幅度接近一个数量级，表现出显著的**“越亮越硬”（harder-when-brighter）**演化趋势，硬度比的离散表明仅靠流量无法单值决定能谱状态；硬波段（$2 - 10\text{ keV}$）与软波段（$0.3 - 2\text{ keV}$）的分数变化量高度相关且能量越高变化越剧烈；整体流量分布呈现出非高斯的**对数正态（lognormal-like）**形态。
2. **能谱模型演化与加速机制转换**：单一幂律谱无法满足拟合要求；样本中有 59 个时段更符合**断幂律（BPL）**模型，17 个时段更符合**对数抛物线（LP）**模型。这种在 BPL 与 LP 之间的模型切换，反映了辐射区在**激波前沿加速**与**下游随机湍流加速**之间的动态转换。
3. **能谱拐折与非经典冷却**：BPL 模型的拐折能量在所有流量状态下均高度聚集在约 $2\text{ keV}$ 附近，且拐折以上的能谱变陡程度极为平缓（平均 $\Delta\Gamma \approx 0.19$），**与标准单区同步辐射冷却模型预言的 $\Delta\Gamma = 0.5$ 存在显著偏离**。
4. **喷流物理启示**：上述长期能谱演化特征强有力地支持了高同步峰耀变体喷流中存在**结构化喷流（Structured Jets）**或**能量依赖的电子逃逸（Energy-Dependent Escape）**机制。
summary: We present a long-term X-ray spectral and timing analysis of the TeV blazar Mrk~421 based on nearly a quarter century of archival \textit{XMM-Newton}/pn observations obtained between 2000 and 2025. Our sample comprises 76 epochs obtained with the pn instrument in both IMAGING and TIMING modes, allowing us to trace the source's variability and spectral evolution. Mrk~421 exhibits flux variations by approximately an order of magnitude, with prominent flaring periods interspersed with low-activity states. A clear harder-when-brighter trend is observed, accompanied by scatter in the hardness ratio (HR), suggesting flux alone does not uniquely determine the spectral state. Fractional variability in the hard band ($2-10$ keV) correlates tightly with that in the soft band ($0.3-2$ keV), with a steeper slope indicating pronounced variability at higher energies. The flux distribution is non-Gaussian and lognormal-like, dominated by moderate flux levels with a tail of bright flares. Spectral analysis shows that power-law model is not sufficient; 59 epochs are best described by a broken power-law (BPL) and 17 by a log-parabola (LP). This fluctuation between BPL and LP models suggests the emission region transitions between a distinct acceleration shockfront and downstream stochastic turbulence. The spectral break energy of BPL remains predominantly clustered around $2$ keV across all flux states, while the average spectral steepening above the break is mild ($ΔΓ\approx 0.19$), inconsistent with standard one-zone cooling models. Our results support structured jet scenarios or energy-dependent electron escape, providing key constraints on the long-term behavior of relativistic jets in high-synchrotron-peaked blazars.

title: Galaxy Protoclusters as Drivers of Cosmic Reionization: II. Te-Based Metallicities of Lyman-α Emitters
background_knowledge: 在宇宙再电离时期（$z \gtrsim 6$），原星系团（Protocluster）作为大尺度物质过密区，聚集了高密度的恒星形成活动，是驱动宇宙介质电离的关键天体环境。气相金属丰度是追踪星系化学演化、气体流动和质量积累历史的核心探针。传统研究常受限于基于经验校准的强发射线方法，存在较大的系统不确定性；而通过探测微弱极光线（如 [O III] $\lambda 4363$）测定电子温度的直接法（$T_e$ 法）能够提供最可靠的金属丰度基准。结合恒星质量构筑的恒星质量-金属丰度关系（Mass-Metallicity Relation, MZR），能够有效揭示原初气体吸积（稀释金属）、恒星核合成（金属富集）以及超新星外流之间的动态平衡，为理解密集环境下早期星系形成演化提供了重要范式。
contribution:
本研究利用 JWST / NIRSpec MSA G395H 高积分光谱数据，结合 NIRCam 与 UltraVISTA 测光，直接测定了红移 $z \approx 6.93$ 的 LAGER-z7OD1 原星系团中 Lyman-$\alpha$ 发射体（LAE）的气相金属丰度，主要结论如下：
1. **精确测定极早期原星系团成员直接金属丰度**：基于 [O III] $\lambda 4363$ 极光线获得了 5 个可靠探测与 1 个测量上限，得到单个星系 $12 + \log(\text{O/H}) \approx 7.2\text{--}8.0$；加权叠加谱测得平均金属丰度为 $12 + \log(\text{O/H}) = 7.76^{+0.06}_{-0.05}$。
2. **过密环境驱动加速化学富集**：叠加样本的金属丰度**比同红移普通场星系 LAE 高出约 0.26 dex**，表明原星系团环境显著加速了早期星系的化学富集与质量组装过程。
3. **强吸积稀释导致的 MZR 系统性偏低**：样本拟合的 MZR 关系（斜率 $\gamma = 0.232 \pm 0.214$，归一化常数 $Z_0 = 7.888 \pm 0.199$）**系统性落于同红移普通星系及原星系团基线下方**。这表明当前观测捕捉到了星系正处于**从星系际介质（IGM）剧烈吸积洁净原初气体的阶段**，吸积在触发剧烈恒星形成（表现为强 LAE）的同时显著稀释了星际介质的金属丰度。
summary: Context. Protoclusters at reionization are thought to host a significant fraction of the cosmic star formation rate density, making them crucial for the timing and topology of reionization. The gas-phase metallicity, a key tracer of galaxy evolutionary stage, can now be measured directly in the early Universe with JWST. Aims. We measure the gas-phase metallicity of Lyman-$α$ emitters (LAEs) in the LAGER-z7OD1 protocluster at $z\approx6.93$ via the direct ($T_e$-based) method using the [O III]$λ$4363 auroral line, and combine it with stellar masses to constrain the mass-metallicity relation (MZR) in dense environments. Methods. We use JWST/NIRSpec MSA G395H spectroscopy, derive metallicities with self-consistent analytic prescriptions, and propagate the dust-extinction uncertainty into an asymmetric error budget via Monte Carlo simulations based on the observed Balmer decrements. Stellar masses come from BEAGLE SED fitting of JWST/NIRCam and UltraVISTA photometry. Results. We obtain five secure [O III]$λ$4363 detections and one upper limit, with 12+log(O/H) $\approx$ 7.2-8.0. The weighted spectral stack yields 12+log(O/H) = $7.76^{+0.06}_{-0.05}$, ~0.26 dex higher than stacks of LAEs at similar redshifts from JWST surveys. However, the MZR fit gives a slope $γ$ = 0.232 +/- 0.214 and normalization $Z_0$ = 7.888 +/- 0.199, placing our sources below the established MZR of normal galaxies and recent protocluster baselines at $z\sim5-7$. Conclusions. The higher metallicity relative to general LAEs suggests accelerated assembly driven by the overdensity, while the offset below the MZR points to a complex interplay between mass build-up and gas accretion. Since we target actively star-forming LAEs, we are likely capturing a phase of pristine gas inflow from the intergalactic medium that fuels star formation but dilutes the interstellar media of these protocluster members.

title: Constraining Primordial Magnetic Fields with Weak Lensing
background_knowledge: 原初磁场（Primordial Magnetic Fields, PMFs）是可能在早期宇宙暴胀或相变时期产生的磁场种子，对解释星系和星系团等大尺度磁场的起源具有关键意义。在宇宙演化过程中，PMFs 施加的洛伦兹力会在小尺度上诱发额外的物质密度涨落，从而显著增强线性和非线性物质功率谱。弱引力透镜效应（Weak Gravitational Lensing）作为探测宇宙大尺度物质分布的强有力探针，通过背景星系形状的微弱形变测量汇聚功率谱 $C_\kappa$，对小尺度的物质功率谱增强极为敏感。然而，在弱透镜的高多极矩（小尺度）区域，重子反馈（Baryon Feedback）和星系内禀取向（Intrinsic Alignment, IA）等天体物理系统效应会影响观测信号，因而需要高精度的数值模拟和仿真器（emulator）进行联合建模与约束。
contribution:
本研究基于包含原初磁场（PMFs）增强效应的初始条件开展了纯暗物质 $N$ 体模拟，计算了非线性物质功率谱及其对应的弱透镜汇聚功率谱 $C_\kappa$，并构建了整合重子反馈与星系内禀取向效应的 $C_\kappa$ 仿真模拟器。基于不同最大多极矩（$\ell_{\rm max}=5000$、$10000$ 和 $20000$）的模拟观测数据开展 MCMC 参数约束，核心发现如下：
1. 在标准 $\Lambda{\rm CDM}$（即无磁场）基准下，于 $95\%$ 置信度下得到原初磁场振幅的上限分别为 **$B_{\rm 1Mpc} < 1.6\text{ nG}$、$1.0\text{ nG}$ 和 $0.8\text{ nG}$**。
2. 磁场参数的恢复精度显著依赖于磁谱指数与观测截断尺度，**$n_B = -2.1$ 的模型因在小尺度汇聚功率谱上产生更强的抬升，比较平缓的 $n_B = -2.7$ 模型更容易被严格约束**。
3. **PMFs 参数与星系内禀取向及重子反馈参数之间未表现出明显的简并性**，而磁场振幅 $B_{\rm 1Mpc}$ 与谱指数 $n_B$ 之间存在内禀简并，文中通过二维后验分布的线性拟合对其进行了参数化表征。
summary: Introducing primordial magnetic fields (PMFs) into the standard cosmological model, $Λ$CDM, has an impact on the matter power spectrum at the linear level, resulting in an increase of power on small scales. In this work, we use the enhanced spectrum as the initial condition for dark-matter-only N-body simulations and study its non-linear evolution. From the resulting non-linear matter power spectrum, we calculate the convergence power spectrum of weak lensing ($C_κ$) and show how the presence of PMFs causes an enhancement at high multipoles. We then construct an emulator for $C_κ$ that also includes intrinsic alignment and baryon feedback. We perform MCMC analyses using mock data generated for different PMF models and for three values of the maximum multipole, $\ell_{\rm max}=5000$, $10000$, and $20000$. The PMFs models are characterized by the two parameters that define the power-law power spectrum of the magnetic field $P_B(k)\propto B_{\rm 1Mpc}^2 k^{n_B}$, where $B_{\rm 1Mpc}$ is the amplitude at a scale of $1$ Mpc and $n_B$ is the power spectral index. For $Λ$CDM mocks, corresponding to $B_{\rm 1Mpc}=0$, we obtain approximate upper limits of $B_{\rm 1Mpc}<1.6$, $1.0$, and $0.8\,{\rm nG}$ at the $95\%$ confidence level for the three values of $\ell_{\rm max}$ respectively. For non-zero input magnetic fields, the recovery of $B_{\rm 1Mpc}$ and $n_B$ depends strongly on the PMFs model and on the maximum multipole considered. Models with $n_B=-2.1$ are more easily constrained than models with $n_B=-2.7$, since they produce a stronger enhancement of the convergence power spectrum. We find no clear degeneracy between the PMFs parameters and the intrinsic alignment or baryon feedback parameters, while $B_{\rm 1Mpc}$ and $n_B$ can be degenerate. We characterize this degeneracy through linear fits to selected $2$D posterior distributions.

title: The star formation history of Orion is structured and episodic
background_knowledge: 恒星通常诞生于巨分子云（Giant Molecular Clouds, GMCs）中气体与尘埃的引力坍缩和碎裂过程。恒星形成并非总是平缓均匀的连续过程，往往受到自引力、湍流、磁场以及大质量恒星反馈（如超新星爆发、恒星风和电离辐射）等内外机制的复杂调制。解析邻近恒星形成复合体（如著名的猎户座 Orion 区域）的恒星形成历史（Star Formation History, SFH），是探究恒星形成触发机制、时空传播模式以及分子云演化生命周期的核心手段。随着高精度天体测量数据（如 Gaia）与先进聚类算法的应用，天文学家能够精确厘清三维空间及运动学聚类成员，重构前所未有高分辨率的恒星年龄序列，从而揭示恒星诞生在时间与空间维度上的精细结构。
contribution: 本研究利用 SigMA 聚类算法识别出的 47 个共空间且共动的恒星群样本及高精度年龄图，重构了猎户座恒星形成区的恒星形成历史。研究发现猎户座的恒星形成呈现出**结构化与阵发性（episodic）**特征，明确检测到四个恒星形成增强期，且各期之间**均存在约 $5\text{ Myr}$ 的时间间隔**。其中，发生于 **$6.4\text{ Myr}$ 与 $11.3\text{ Myr}$ 前**的两次增强最为显著且统计稳健，孕育了该区域约 **$59\%$ 的恒星**；更早的增强期则位于 $16.2\text{ Myr}$ 和 $21.4\text{ Myr}$ 前。值得注意的是，该 $\sim 5\text{ Myr}$ 的时间间隔与天蝎-半人马座（Sco-Cen）恒星形成区所呈现的周期尺度惊人一致，尽管两者的具体空间演化模式存在差异。此外，论文识别出了包括 3 个星团链候选体在内的时空关联结构，并排除了方法学偏差，为探索巨分子云中普遍存在的周期性或阶段性恒星形成触发机制提供了重要线索。
summary: The propagation of star formation throughout a molecular cloud complex can tell us much about its physical drivers and the importance of environmental versus intrinsic processes. We reconstruct the star formation history (SFH) of the Orion star-forming complex using the highest-resolution age map currently available. It comprises 47 co-spatial and co-moving groups identified by the SigMA clustering algorithm, with homogeneously derived ages and group memberships. We find four periods of increased star formation, separated by ~5 Myr each. The two periods of highest increase, at 6.4 and 11.3 Myr, can be statistically localized, together hold ca. 59% of all stars, and are robust against resampling and changes to the age fitting. The two older, smaller increases at 16.2 and 21.4 Myr can be identified in the age distribution, but cannot be shown to be robust at this point. The ~5 Myr spacing between the episodes of increased star formation is the same as found for the nearby Scorpius-Centaurus (Sco-Cen) star-forming region. We find no methodological bias that could produce the SFH structure. We identify spatio-temporally connected structures, including three cluster-chain candidates. We conclude that star formation in Orion seems to occur on the same timescales but with a different pattern than in Sco-Cen. The cause of the ~5 Myr separations remains a mystery, and its detection in two distinct star-forming regions needs further investigation.

title: Inferring radio beams from sparse sampling patterns: a case study with the Murchison Widefield Array
background_knowledge: 宇宙再电离时期（Epoch of Reionisation, EoR）是宇宙演化史上的关键阶段，中性氢的红移 $21\text{ cm}$ 超精细跃迁辐射是探测这一时期宇宙结构演化与第一代天体形成的最重要探针之一。然而，微弱的宇宙学 $21\text{ cm}$ 信号往往被强出数个数量级的银河系同步辐射及河外射电源等前景辐射所淹没。在低频射电干涉测量（如默奇森宽场阵列 MWA、SKA-Low 等）中，为了实现高动态范围的前景扣除并防止色散前景泄漏至“EoR 窗口”，必须对接收天线的主波束（Primary Beam）响应建立极高精度的物理与数学模型。由于实际天线阵元存在制造公差、环境耦合和结构退化等因素，电磁仿真所得的理想波束与真实天线方向图常存在不可忽视的偏差，利用已知轨道的人造卫星机会发射信号对低频天线波束进行在轨实测与标定已成为该领域的重要研究手段。
contribution: 本研究利用重新处理的人造卫星过轨观测数据，对默奇森宽场阵列（Murchison Widefield Array, MWA）在 $137\text{ MHz}$ 天顶指向下的天线功率波束进行了精确推断。论文开发了两种互补的贝叶斯推断框架：一种是**基于单个偶极子复数变化的物理参数化模型**，另一种是**用于灵活重构方向相关精细结构的分层样条（hierarchical spline）模型**。观测反演结果显示，实际波束呈现出**更浅且发生位置偏移的波束零点（nulls）以及相干的旁瓣（sidelobe）畸变**；物理偶极子模型能有效刻画大尺度轮廓偏差，而样条模型则成功恢复了局部细节且对孤立过轨伪影保持高度稳健。此外，基于四个各自仅占总数据量约 $20\%$ 的独立 20 天子数据集，研究在整个可见半球重构出了**高度一致的零点和旁瓣形态**，有力证明了**利用卫星机会辐射开展实用且可重复的低频波束原位重构的可行性**，并为未来全 Jones 矩阵响应测量奠定了基础。
summary: Accurate primary-beam models are essential for high-dynamic-range radio experiments, particularly searches for the redshifted 21-cm signal from the Epoch of Reionisation, where beam errors can couple bright foreground emission into the faint cosmological measurement. Using reprocessed satellite observations we infer the 137-MHz, zenith-pointed power beams of Murchison Widefield Array receiving elements. We develop two complementary Bayesian approaches for quantifying departures from nominal electromagnetic simulations: a physically motivated model of complex variations among individual dipoles and a hierarchical spline model for flexible direction-dependent structure. The measurements reveal shallower and displaced nulls together with coherent sidelobe deformations. The dipole model captures much of this broad structure, whereas the spline recovers additional localised features while remaining largely robust to isolated pass-shaped artefacts. Despite their sparse and distinct sampling patterns, four independent 20-day subsets, each containing approximately 20\% of the full dataset, recover consistent null and sidelobe morphology across the visible hemisphere. These results demonstrate that opportunistic satellite transmissions can support practical, repeatable beam reconstruction, while motivating future chromatic, phase-referenced measurements of the full Jones response.

title: Which Milky Way Streams Make the Best Dark Matter Detectors?
background_knowledge: 在标准冷暗物质（$\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$）宇宙学模型中，暗物质晕内部预言存在海量的低质量暗物质子晕（subhalos）。然而，由于光致电离加热和超新星反馈等重子物理过程的抑制，低于星系形成阈值（约 $10^8 M_\odot$ 以下）的低质量子晕往往无法有效形成恒星，成为完全不可见的“纯暗晕”。球状星团在银河系引力潮汐作用下瓦解形成的冷星流（stellar streams）结构狭窄且速度弥散极小，对引力扰动异常敏感。当无光的暗物质子晕近距离穿过或掠过星流时，其引力场会在星流中诱发密度间隙（gaps）和特征性的速度踢角（velocity kicks）。因此，高精度的星流形态与动力学观测成为在近邻宇宙中探测低质量暗物质子晕丰度与结构、进而检验暗物质粒子物理模型的强力探针。
contribution: 本文利用半解析模型 Galacticus 模拟了包含银盘潮汐剥离效应的银河系暗物质子晕演化，并结合与当前观测匹配的星流轨道初始条件，对银河系内 24 条球状星团星流与暗子晕的相遇事件进行了系统预测。研究表明：**扰动最显著的 10 条星流在其生命周期内预计各自经历 $\approx 2\text{--}12$ 次速度扰动 $v_\mathrm{kick} > 0.1\text{ km s}^{-1}$ 的显著相遇**；其中 **Jet、AAU、GD-1 和 Palomar 5 是最佳探测目标**，Jet 经历的相遇次数达到其他任何星流的两倍以上。模拟还发现，**与星流相遇的暗子晕普遍经历了极强的潮汐剥离，其现存质量仅为其峰值质量的 $1\%\text{--}20\%$，且致密程度是以往假设的两倍**。作者指出，具备**亚 $\text{km s}^{-1}$ 精度**的恒星光谱巡天有望揭示低于星系形成阈值的纯暗晕特征，而准确约束进入内银河系的低质量子晕丰度与弥散度仍是连接星流观测与暗物质理论模型的首要不确定性。
summary: The abundance and properties of low-mass dark matter subhalos can be inferred by measuring the density and velocity structure of stellar streams, testing physical models of dark matter. Which streams make the most promising dark matter detectors, and which subhalos would they encounter? We use the semi-analytic model galacticus to simulate the Milky Way's dark subhalos, including tidal stripping under the influence of the galactic disk. Deriving stream initial conditions that best match present-day observations, we forecast subhalo encounters for 24 globular cluster streams around the Milky Way. Over their lifetimes, the 10 most perturbed streams are predicted to each experience $\approx 2$-$12$ significant subhalo encounters with velocity kicks $v_\mathrm{kick} > 0.1$ km s$^{-1}$. Jet, AAU, GD-1, and Palomar 5 lead the list, with Jet encountering twice the subhalos of any other stream. The subhalos that encounter streams have been tidally stripped to $1$-$20\%$ of their peak mass and are twice as compact as previous works have assumed. A spectroscopic survey of streams with sub-km s$^{-1}$ precision could reveal the influence of dark subhalos below the threshold of galaxy formation. Predicting the abundance and scatter of low-mass subhalos that reach the inner galaxy remains a dominant uncertainty in connecting stellar streams to models of dark matter.

title: Gaia neutron stars: demographics, birth rates, and connections to other neutron star populations
background_knowledge: 中子星是经历超新星爆发后形成的大质量恒星致密遗迹。传统上，银河系中子星主要通过射电脉冲星或 X 射线双星等辐射特征被发现。然而，绝大多数处于非吸积、宽轨道双星系统中的中子星是“休眠”且不可见的，难以用传统电磁手段探测。近年来，Gaia 空间望远镜的高精度天体测量技术通过监测可见伴星的周期性天体测量摆动，首次在天文单位（au）尺度的轨道上直接证认了一批带有类太阳伴星的休眠中子星候选体。理解这类新型中子星系统的轨道参数分布、质量函数以及空间产生率，对揭示超新星爆发中的激冲效应（natal kick）、双星演化途径（如共有包层阶段或弱反冲超新星机制）以及银河系致密天体全景图谱具有重要物理意义。
contribution:
本研究基于 Gaia DR3 发现的 27 个中子星候选体，构建了详尽的 Gaia 选择效应模型，并结合分层贝叶斯框架推断了此类中子星双星系统的固有星族（intrinsic demographics）特征：

1. **固有轨道与质量分布**：发现其固有轨道周期呈现幂律递减分布（幂律斜率 $\alpha_P = -0.75 \pm 0.35$）；伴星质量分布峰值位于 $M_1 \approx 0.85~{\rm M_\odot}$（弥散度 $\sigma_{M_1} \approx 0.2~{\rm M_\odot}$）；中子星质量分布峰值集中在 $M_{\rm NS} \approx 1.3~{\rm M_\odot}$ 且延伸至更高质量端；偏心率分布显著偏向中高偏心率。
2. **空间密度与发现率预测**：推导出太阳系附近 $2~{\rm kpc}$ 范围内的固有空间密度为 $n \approx 120~{\rm kpc^{-3}}$，表明**目前仅探测到了邻近该类中子星总量的约 $3\%$**。进一步预测 **Gaia DR4 将把此类样本量提升至 $300 \sim 650$ 颗**，并探测到更长周期的系统以直接检验双星演化理论。
3. **银河系整体背景与诞生率**：揭示了全银河系中**仅有 $0.01\% \sim 1\%$ 的中子星诞生于此类带有类太阳伴星的 au 尺度轨道系统**。其诞生率比大质量 X 射线双星（HMXBs）低 $10 \sim 100$ 倍，但与共生 X 射线双星（symbiotic X-ray binaries）大致相当。
summary: Gaia DR3 revealed a new class of neutron stars (NSs) in au-scale orbits with solar-type companions. How these 'Gaia NSs' form remains unclear, and constraining their intrinsic population properties is a necessary step toward understanding their origin. However, the current sample of 27 Gaia NS candidates is strongly biased by Gaia's astrometric sensitivity. In this work, we carefully model the Gaia selection function and incorporate it into a hierarchical Bayesian framework to infer the \textit{intrinsic} demographics of the Gaia NS population. We find that the population favors a decreasing period distribution with power-law slope $α_P=-0.75 \pm 0.35$, a visible-star mass distribution peaked near $M_1\approx 0.85~{\rm M_\odot}$ ($σ_{M_1} \approx 0.2~{\rm M_\odot}$), an NS mass distribution peaked near $M_{\rm NS}\approx 1.3~{\rm M_\odot}$ with a tail towards higher masses, and an eccentricity distribution weighted toward moderate-to-large eccentricities. The intrinsic space density is $n\approx120~{\rm kpc^{-3}}$ within 2 kpc, implying that only $\sim3\%$ of the local Gaia NS population has been discovered so far. Our forecasts predict that Gaia DR4 will increase the sample to $\sim300$-650 NS candidates, including access to longer orbital periods that will provide direct tests of formation models. Finally, we place Gaia NSs in the context of the broader Galactic NS population by comparing their intrinsic birth rate, lifetime, and size to other classes of isolated and binary NSs. Only 0.01% - 1% of all NSs are born into au-scale orbits with solar-type companions, making the birth rate of Gaia NSs 10 - 100 times smaller than that of high-mass X-ray binaries and broadly comparable to symbiotic X-ray binaries.
